description: Multiple truths can exist at the same time, learning to detach opens doors for flexibility ☕️ #fyp #IntentionalLiving #LifeByDesign
transcript: Multiple things can be the truth at the same time and that is truly such a gift because I'm leaning into the understanding of detachment and how important it is to understand that everything can go on at the same time and it does not make this bad and it doesn't make this better. It really is what it is and in turn I don't have to desire an outcome because all the outcomes are what they are meant to be.
